author: Unknown; Jewish tradition names Jeremiah
date: Events c. 970–850 BC; completed during the exile (c. 560 BC)
overview: Solomon becomes king, asks God for wisdom, and builds the temple in Jerusalem. After his death the kingdom splits in two: Israel in the north and Judah in the south. The prophet Elijah confronts King Ahab and the worship of Baal.
storyPlace: From the height of Israel's kingdom to its division.
